summary: The question premise needs correction: n81 does not flip Prača to RBiH. Both runs start Prača under RBiH; n80 captures it for RS at turn 26, while n81 omits that capture and therefore remains RBiH. The missing capture is traced through Operation Kijevo's missing Prača axis to rs_4th_sarajevo_light_infantry being held by a turn-23 probe when Kijevo is built. Retained artifacts show an earlier global trajectory divergence at turn 4 consistent with the new global pre-T3 helper, but do not record the helper call or its pre/post order, so the helper is associated with the changed trajectory rather than proved as the first writer.

controls.positive_selector: n80 target lookup finds exactly one native Prača control event and one Operation Kijevo AAR containing Prača
controls.schema: both weekly files have 188 parseable rows; both temporal logs parse; target has canonical three-component OSID shape

turn_week_binding.weekly_report: week_index 26 contains the turn-26 Prača battle
turn_week_binding.brigade_temporal_log: turn 26 row carries week_index 25; this harness artifact is one less than its turn field
turn_week_binding.checkpoint: save_w39 evaluates turn 39 and sees n80 RS versus n81 RBiH

event_actor_chain.detail: op:pale:praca RBiH→RS; battle_id 26:op:pale:praca:rs_4th_sarajevo_light_infantry:arbih_851st_vitezka_liberation; attacking lead rs_4th_sarajevo_light_infantry; defenders arbih_851st_vitezka_liberation and arbih_181st_mountain; decisive victory and territory_flipped=true. n81 has no Prača control event.

event_actor_chain.event: n81 retains RBiH rather than recapturing
event_actor_chain.detail: n81's only Prača engagement is turn 172, a catastrophic failed RS probe by rs_5th_podrinje with territory_flipped=false.

event_actor_chain.event: Operation Kijevo roster and axis divergence
event_actor_chain.detail: n80 Kijevo starts turn 24 with rs_1st_romanija_infantry, rs_2nd_sarajevo_light_infantry and rs_4th_sarajevo_light_infantry; its praca_approach axis captures Prača at turn 26. n81 Kijevo starts turn 24 with only the first two brigades, contains only kijevo_shoulder, captures Kijevo at turn 25 and ends turn 26.

event_actor_chain.event: rs_4th is excluded because it is already committed
event_actor_chain.detail: n81 temporal rows show rs_4th committed to probe_vrs_sarajevo_romanija_t23 in planning at turn 23 and recovery at turn 24, exactly when Kijevo begins. pre_planned_operations.ts collectCommittedFormationIds records every active-operation participant and buildAxesFromDef rejects committedElsewhere at lines 1904, 1934 and 1965. This proves the roster exclusion predicate, not why the probe was selected.

At turn 22/week_index 21, n80 personnel is 1405 and n81 is 1516; location, movement destination, operation, cohesion, morale and fatigue still agree. n80 receives the comparable +105 replenishment one turn later. Retained reports do not identify the writer or pool decision that shifted this replenishment.

At turn 4/week_index 3, rs_1st_armored and rs_5th_kozara_light_infantry are both Operation Prijedor participants at Rasavci and in transit. n80 post-turn destination is op:prijedor:kozarac_2; n81 is op:prijedor:ljubija_2. Operation Prijedor's AAR is otherwise identical and shows both as sequential captured objectives on prijedor_clean. The first aggregate weekly difference appears later at week_index 7 in column_movement and movement_report.

candidate_source.source_supported_shape: The helper globally scans pending bot_discretionary column orders with no transit, requires unique live operation/axis membership and a completed earlier objective, then replaces that destination with an approach to the current objective immediately before T3. The turn-4 Operation Prijedor destination divergence is consistent with this shape.

telemetry.limit: The exact n81 C append is attributable via the archived before/after boundary and runner receipt, but its directive-chain schema contains neither Prača nor rs_4th and does not observe the helper. Zero matches are not evidence that the helper did not run.

causal_assessment.actual: n81 misses the turn-26 capture because Kijevo omits rs_4th and the complete Prača axis; source proves the live probe commitment causes that roster exclusion.
causal_assessment.inferred: The globally activated pre-T3 reconciliation is the only candidate change and the turn-4 destination difference matches its designed predicate, so it is the strongest upstream suspect for the changed deterministic trajectory.
causal_assessment.unresolved: No retained artifact records the first helper invocation, order owner, old/new destinations and guard results at the call boundary. The chain from the turn-4 Prijedor rewrite to turn-22 rs_4th replenishment and turn-23 probe selection is therefore not directly measured.

recommendation.disposition: Keep n81 rejected and do not adopt the global pre-T3 prepass. Withdrawing an unaccepted candidate is safe disposition, not a claimed mechanism fix.
recommendation.reason_no_mechanic_fix: The retained evidence does not establish which helper predicate is overbroad or whether the turn-4 rewrite is itself unlawful; a date, OSID, operation-name exception, or new opt-in would be a guess.
recommendation.smallest_next_measurement: If another bounded run is authorized, add an observer-only receipt immediately around reconcileStaleOperationMarchOrders. For every replacement, record turn, brigade, pre/post owner+stance+destination, physical location, effective host, operation id/name/phase, axis id, objective list/current index/capture count, prior-objective controller, each preservation guard result, approaches, and selected replacement. Also record a terminal no-change receipt and selector coverage. This is the minimum evidence needed to prove the first writer and choose a systemic predicate correction.

limits: No root-cause claim is made for the turn-22 replenishment shift or turn-23 probe creation.
No gameplay mechanic, source rollback, date patch, OSID exception, operation-name exception, acceptance recovery, or new score is claimed.
All inherited acceptance gates remain unmet; retained n80 remains the only baseline.
